name: justcore-showcase
description: Independently built micro frontends in React, Vue, Svelte, SolidJS, Angular and Astro, loaded from a CDN into one justcore shell.

scripts.build:mfes: npm run build --workspace vendor && npm run build --workspace mfes/navigation --workspace mfes/header --workspace mfes/catalog --workspace mfes/product-detail --workspace mfes/cart --workspace mfes/recommendations
scripts.build: npm run build:mfes && node scripts/publish.mjs header navigation catalog product-detail cart recommendations && npm run build --workspace shell
scripts.build:faults: SHOWCASE_FAULT=start SHOWCASE_VERSION=2.1.0 npm run build --workspace mfes/recommendations && SHOWCASE_FAULT=click SHOWCASE_VERSION=2.1.0 npm run build --workspace mfes/product-detail
